PM advises mantris to be aware of facts & counter negative narratives
Iowa rescue mission turns thrift store into 46-bed shelter, frees space for 25 beds
stories.summary: Dubuque Rescue Mission will close its thrift store to create a 46-bed emergency shelter for men. The decision is in response to rising demand for shelter and increased homelessness in Dubuque. The change will free up additional space for women and children with the help of Opening Doors. All donations will be redirected to another thrift store or partner organizations for women's needs.

stories.title: In 2015, a US man paid $5.99 for a watch; after it was confirmed authentic, he sold it for $35,000
stories.summary: While exploring a Goodwill store, Zach Norris found a vintage LeCoultre Deep Sea Alarm watch priced at merely $5.99. After confirming its authenticity, the buzz around the watch attracted collectors from all over, culminating in significant bids. Renowned collector Eric Ku eventually acquired it for more than $35,000. This fortunate sale supported Norris's wedding plans and allowed him to obtain a cherished timepiece, with some proceeds given back to Goodwill.

stories.title: NRI man says wife in India turned into operations manager handling cook, maid and deep-cleaning service: Domestic help doesn't mean zero effort

Aaya Ram, gaya Ram, phir aaya Ram: SC dismisses Danam Nagender's plea, sets stage for high-octane assembly by-election
stories.summary: The Supreme Court confirmed the Telangana high court's decision to disqualify Danam Nagender as Khairatabad MLA. This ruling prompted an impending by-election that will take place in the region. Nagender had previously won the assembly seat representing BRS, but later lost a Lok Sabha election while contesting for Congress. The court emphasized that Nagender's actions were inconsistent with party loyalty, justifying the disqualification.

stories.title: JD Vance's H-1B warning to corporate America: We are not going to let you lay off American workers so you can replace them with cheap foreign labor
After 59 years, Ripley’s San Francisco museum and mirror maze are closing by year-end
In 1843, Mexico granted 22,000 acres in California's Cuyama Valley; 183 years later...
stories.summary: Spanish Ranch, a historic 5,650-acre property from the 1843 Mexican land grant, is safely protected from any future development. This initiative not only bolsters sustainable agricultural practices but also safeguards diverse wildlife habitats. A dedicated fundraising campaign, achieving an impressive $1 million, was spearheaded by the California Rangeland Trust, supported by generous contributions from private donors and conservation programs.

stories.title: In 1888, George Vanderbilt began building a vast North Carolina estate; 26 years later, his widow...
stories.summary: In 1914, Edith Vanderbilt made a landmark decision by selling 86,700 acres of land to the federal government for conservation purposes, significantly below market value. This generous act was aimed at promoting her late husband's vision of preserving essential forests. The area ultimately became Pisgah National Forest in 1916, laying the groundwork for ecological protection and setting a visionary example for public land conservation in the eastern U.S.

stories.title: Indian YouTuber faces racist attack in Vegas, offered 7-11 job; he says to harassers 'you look too poor'
'No eligible elector will be left behind': Goa CEO clarifies on 97 missing voters
stories.summary: The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa has provided clarity regarding the exclusion of 97 voters from the electoral rolls. These individuals were initially identified due to discrepancies reported during the Special Intensive Revision process. However, follow-up house visits successfully registered many eligible voters. This incident has raised concerns over the reliability of the Election Commission's ECINet software, prompting criticism from opposition parties about electoral registration procedures and centralization.

stories.title: In 2022, Naomi Osaka paid $6.3 million for a Los Angeles home then sold it back for...
stories.summary: Nick and Vanessa Lachey have put their stunning Tarzana estate back on the market, asking for nearly $8.2 million. This luxurious property, which they repurchased from tennis star Naomi Osaka, features a wealth of fitness-oriented amenities added during Osaka's ownership, including a high-end recovery suite and a custom gym. The real estate exchange highlights the ever-evolving landscape of celebrity properties in Los Angeles.

stories.title: John Oates’ Colorado ranch built from scratch sells for $6.9M
stories.summary: John Oates and Aimee Oates turned a barren 4.3-acre land into the picturesque Little Woody Creek Ranch in Colorado. After spending countless holidays there, they decided to sell the property as their visits became less frequent. Initially priced at $6 million, then raised to $7.5 million, the property features a charming five-bedroom log home. By July 2024, they finalized the sale at $6.

stories.title: Uttarakhand CM Dhami flags off 4 successful NIM mountaineering expeditions, lauds climbers' courage and team spirit
stories.summary: Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami on Thursday flagged off four successful mountaineering expeditions conducted by the Nehru Institute of Mountaineering (NIM) in Uttarkashi, at the Chief Minister's Camp Office in Dehradun.

stories.title: Xi Jinping tests Donald Trump with 'Thucydides Trap'
stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping asserted that the US and China should work together to avoid conflict. He emphasized that China's rise does not have to threaten the United States' position. Despite past confrontational rhetoric, President Trump responded positively, highlighting their relationship. Critics remain skeptical, arguing that China's military expansion poses significant risks. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stressed the importance of engaging with China amidst these challenges.

stories.title: Food warnings must drive reformulation, says ex-FSSAI chief
FSSAI moves to bar use of ‘paneer’ for non-dairy analogues
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has proposed a restriction on the term 'paneer'. Products not made from milk-derived ingredients would be prohibited from using this term. The proposed amendment is a response to consumer protection concerns regarding misleading product names. FSSAI has defined these products specifically to ensure clarity in labeling.

stories.title: Stanford AI row: Students outraged as university uses AI to alter Hispanic student with Black student in promotional ad
An Alabama man fought a power company over a 74-mile transmission line across his property
stories.summary: A landowner in Shelby County, Alabama, has secured a temporary court order stopping utility crews from clearing his land. The order halts construction for a new power line project, which would have impacted his property. It was determined that Alabama Power may not have followed proper procedures before initiating condemnation. The landowner argues that the chosen route would divide his property and harm local wildlife.

stories.title: Panda diplomacy: Xi announces 2 giant pandas for Atlanta zoo in US
SC flags ‘false’ POCSO cases in marital disputes, bars immediate arrest of accused parent
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has stressed the need for cautious evaluations prior to immediate arrests under the POCSO Act. They underscored the crucial role of expert child assessments when parents are under scrutiny. In matrimonial conflicts, police are urged to confirm relationships before making arrests. The court expressed concern over the rising incidents of false allegations in family disputes, highlighting the importance of in-depth investigations prioritizing children's welfare.

stories.title: ‘US and China should coexist in peace’: Xi meets Trump at White House
'No trust in EC': Akhilesh Yadav alleges ‘vote theft’ in 2022 UP polls, says SP will contest 2027 in alliance
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav addressed a public meeting in Raebareli, alleging the Election Commission assisted in vote theft during 2022. He stated that the Samajwadi Party would have formed the government without these irregularities. Yadav emphasized the importance of an alliance for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections based on winnability. He criticized the BJP for communal politics and promised various reforms if elected.

stories.title: Government expands the list of permitted chemicals for storage in coastal areas
Gavin Newsom's San Francisco childhood home listed for $4.5 million after major renovation
stories.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom’s San Francisco childhood home has been listed for $4.5 million after an extensive renovation. The Cole Valley property, where Newsom lived during his early childhood, was originally owned by his maternal grandfather and later inherited by his mother, Tessa. The Newsom family sold the property in the 1970s.

stories.title: Draft National Electricity Policy moved for inter-ministerial consultation
In New York, 29 million discarded glass bottles were ground into concrete for JPMorgan headquarters
stories.summary: A groundbreaking skyscraper in Midtown Manhattan ingeniously incorporates 29 million recycled bottles as structural elements, tackling both environmental and construction hurdles. The project innovatively replaces Portland cement with ground-glass pozzolan, dramatically cutting down carbon emissions. Despite the ecological materials, engineers adhered to an expedited construction timeline, while the glass-infused concrete combats urban heat. This pioneering effort has sparked a broader adoption of ground-glass pozzolan in local infrastructure endeavors.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico seek emergency hearing after White House denies access despite court order
Widow of Indian-origin pilot killed in helicopter accident minutes after wedding in Georgia sues venue, chopper company
Palestinian president delivers UN speech by video after US denies visa again

Did AI-‘kill chain’ lead to deadly Iran school strike? What report claims
stories.summary: A devastating missile strike by the US on a school in Minab, Iran, has led to the tragic loss of over 150 lives, including 123 innocent children. Investigations uncovered serious issues in the military’s targeting tactics, pointing to outdated intelligence and a lack of comprehensive civilian harm evaluations. The AI-powered Maven Smart System was crucial in target assessments.

stories.title: Mecca in crosshairs again: Saudi Arabia sounds alarm for holy city for 2nd time in a month
'All elections rigged, laws illegal': Rahul Gandhi attacks Centre over EC-SIR row; BJP calls it 'jooth ki goonj'
stories.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has intensified accusations against the government and the Election Commission regarding electoral integrity. He demands the immediate resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing evidence of electoral manipulation. Concerns regarding unresolved objections from Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi further bolster his claims. The BJP has responded by rejecting his allegations and challenging his assertions about anti-incumbency.

stories.title: 'We know what delay did in Shiv Sena': On TMC symbol row, SC asks EC to set time limit for final decision
stories.summary: The Supreme Court instructed the Election Commission to provide reasonable time for both factions in the Trinamool Congress dispute. The court emphasized the need for prompt resolution to avoid delays seen in other political party disputes. Senior Advocate Kapil Sibal represented Mamata Banerjee, arguing that the Election Commission's order left her client without an effective remedy.

stories.title: Minnesota girl, 12, wins $10Kprize for her global anti-hate campaign
stories.summary: Natalie Flaherty, a 12-year-old from Minnesota, received the Gloria Barron Prize for her initiative against hate. She started her campaign, 'I Stand with Anne', by distributing bracelets that promote kindness. Flaherty's project evolved into a nationwide movement, reaching all 50 states and beyond. She plans to use her prize money to continue her advocacy and educational work on hate.

stories.title: In 2000, California packed 662,700 shredded waste tires beneath an I-880 on-ramp; they cut...
stories.summary: Engineers faced challenges while upgrading a highway interchange in Milpitas due to unstable bay mud. They opted to use shredded waste tires as lightweight fill to prevent ground settlement. This choice reduced weight on the soft soil by 40 percent and saved significant project costs. Over two decades, the infrastructure has shown no maintenance issues or structural damage.

stories.title: POCSO case cannot be quashed on settlement, says Delhi HC
stories.summary: In a significant ruling, the Delhi HC determined that proceedings under the POCSO Act must continue, regardless of any compromises reached by the involved parties. Justice Sachin Datta emphasized the serious nature of child sexual assault, asserting that these offenses have profound societal ramifications worthy of prosecution. The court invoked a Supreme Court precedent, reminding that the victimization of children deserves vigilant attention, beyond personal settlements.

stories.title: 'No anti-incumbency against BJP?' Party counters Rahul Gandhi with Tamil Nadu, Bengal poll history
Man lost lamp in cave in 1953; became a NASA scientist, found it 68 years later
'Allow arrested Congress candidate to contest Nandigram bypoll': HC's oral direction to West Bengal govt
Tech industry group urges Trump administration to drop $103,265 H-1B fee proposal, asks how Silicon Valley will hire top talents
Straitcraft: How geography gives Iran leverage and could do the same for India
stories.summary: Since the onset of the US-Iran war over 200 days ago, Iran has been strategically utilizing maritime chokepoints such as Hormuz. This has resulted in a marked decline in oil flows, affecting the global economy and forcing the US to reconsider its stance. Concurrently, India is exploring ways to capitalize on its geographical advantages against China.

stories.title: 'Jhoot ki goonj by frustrated leader': BJP mocks Rahul Gandhi's presser on EC-SIR row
Evening news wrap: Rahul targets Centre, CEC amid SIR row; Iran threatens to extend war to Indian Ocean in case of new US strikes & more
An English artist paid £2,090 for a painting listed only as ‘in the style of’ Helen McNicoll
stories.summary: David Taylor made an astonishing find at a UK auction when he acquired an oil painting incorrectly attributed to Helen McNicoll for just £2,090. After expert examination, it was confirmed to be McNicoll's masterpiece, The Bean Harvest, appraised at £300,000. Canadian collector Pierre Lassonde later purchased the artwork for £174,000, ensuring its return to public viewing after a century, highlighting the often-hidden treasures lurking in regional auction houses.

stories.title: White House bars Politico reporter again despite judge's access order
Meet Lucas Rojas, 16, who turned one inclusive kickball game into a six-team league with 40+ players
stories.summary: Lucas Rojas launched LINKball, a vibrant kickball league designed to unite students with special needs and enthusiastic volunteers. Starting from a charity match, this initiative blossomed into a well-organized league of six teams. Acknowledging his impactful work, Rojas was awarded the $10,000 Gloria Barron Prize. Each season sees over 40 players and 60 volunteers engaging in the program, promoting inclusivity and teamwork through the joy of sports.

stories.title: Seattle’s 'Inconvenience Store': Former 7-Eleven sells tangled USBs, fake corn dogs and more
'Vote chori, kanoon chori, sanstha chori': Rahul Gandhi tears into PM Modi, Amit Shah, CEC Gyanesh Kumar amid SIR row
'No anti-incumbency for BJP': Rahul Gandhi namedrops Saddam, Kim Jong Un to attack Modi govt, EC
Delhi HC denies anticipatory bail to YouTuber Ajeet Bharti in casteist remarks case
stories.summary: Delhi High Court rejected Ajeet Bharti's request for anticipatory bail in a caste-related case. The court determined that a prima facie case was established under the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes Act. Bharti's remarks were deemed derogatory and part of a public social media discussion. His lawyer argued against the applicability of the SC/ST Act based on provocation.

stories.title: 'Needs a miracle': Son of Israeli ambassador to US injured in West Bank ramming attack
The Backstory: When EC disagreements went public, from Seshan to Lavasa
stories.summary: The Election Commission is facing fresh scrutiny after an Indian Express report highlighted disagreements among its members over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. The dispute recalls two earlier episodes of internal dissent: TN Seshan’s legal battle over the multi-member poll panel in the 1990s and Ashok Lavasa’s dissent during the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. Both cases shaped debates over the EC’s functioning and authority.

stories.title: 1 killed, 4 injured in knife attack at Benedictine abbey in Poland
Michael Tilson Thomas’ 32-year home is now on sale for $9.85M
stories.summary: Michael Tilson Thomas’s residence in Pacific Heights is now on the market following his passing earlier this year. The mansion was a sanctuary for the musician and his husband Joshua Robison for nearly three decades. Built in 1906, the four-level home features a blend of architectural styles and modern amenities added over the years. Its spacious rooms hosted numerous distinguished guests from the music and architecture worlds.

stories.title: 800,000 bees stolen in Australia; thieves left honey and took colonies
'Manipulated the voter rolls': Mahua Moitra files police complaint against Gyanesh Kumar over SIR row
stories.summary: TMC MP Mahua Moitra has filed a police complaint against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging manipulation of voter rolls. Moitra raised specific concerns over unauthorized amendments to Form 6 related to voter registration. Her allegations came a day after a report stated that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections at least 14 times over 10 months to decisions and orders related to the SIR.

FSSAI proposes to ban 'paneer' label for substitute products, ensure strict disclosure
New California amoeba sets heat record for complex life at 145°F
Florida businessman’s 4 beach lots to become public after a decade and multiple lawsuits
stories.summary: Michael Holderness bought four beachfront lots on Florida’s Siesta Key in 2016 and 2017, leading to years of disputes with Sarasota County over public access and development. Under a settlement, the county will receive the four lots and make them public beach property, while Holderness gets a nearby parcel valued at nearly $2.8 million, $500,000 and permission to build a 5,000-square-foot home.

stories.title: Florida crew found a python guarding a huge egg clutch; both were removed
London residents turn food scraps into sauna fuel as community sauna is tested

Solar pump removes 65,000 gallons of contaminated groundwater in two years in CA
When the umpires disagree: 10 questions at the heart of the Election Commission row
stories.summary: The Election Commission is facing questions over reported disagreements between two election commissioners and the CEC on electoral-roll management, decision-making and access to voter data. The controversy has also revived broader concerns over how dissent is handled within the poll panel, the role of the CEC, the appointment of election commissioners and safeguards for voters during large-scale roll revisions.

stories.title: Ontario mother of 10 says she received C$6,300 from C$19,000 GoFundMe; sister charged with fraud
stories.summary: Maryanne Mullett, an Ontario mother of ten, sustained injuries while assisting stranded drivers in January 2026. A dedicated GoFundMe campaign raised about C$19,000 to assist her recovery and family needs. Unfortunately, she received merely C$6,300, leading to financial disputes. A family member faces fraud charges related to the funds, and Mullett has since launched a new fundraiser, highlighting the critical need for better protections in crowdfunding efforts.

stories.title: Florida gas prices surge as some stations charge over $5
stories.summary: Drivers in Florida are experiencing rising petrol prices, with some stations exceeding $5 a gallon. The statewide average has reached $4.29 per gallon, the highest since May. This increase is significantly influenced by rising global oil prices caused by geopolitical tensions. As crude oil prices rise, consumers in Florida and beyond are facing higher costs at the pump.

stories.title: 'Should act fairly': Calcutta HC slams EC for assigning 'envelope' symbol to rival TMC faction
stories.summary: In a recent ruling, the Calcutta high court expressed discontent towards the Election Commission concerning its symbol allocation to the Democratic Trinamool Congress. The court challenged the integrity of the symbol distribution process, pointing out the existence of numerous alternatives. Justice Krishna Rao remarked on the legal issues created by these decisions, leading to appeals from parties involved.

The couple plans to raise cattle there while giving children hands-on experiences in farming, conservation, fishing, hunting and land management.

stories.title: Mexican immigrant couple closes Colorado restaurant after 31 years as children build their own lives
stories.summary: A Colorado couple who moved from Mexico in 1995 with their three children opened Los Tarascos and ran it for 31 years. Jose and Maria Caballero are now closing the Fort Collins restaurant, saying they have achieved the dream that brought them to the US: giving their children the chance to build independent lives and careers outside the family business.

She mentioned that he unexpectedly appeared at her residence, causing her significant distress. In response, Nosiiree denied allegations of stalking during his own livestream, professing his love for KitsuFox and voicing concerns about their personal disputes becoming public knowledge.

Rep. Brad Sherman is set to bring these alarming issues to the attention of California Attorney General Rob Bonta. Disturbingly, customers reported spending significant sums while feeling pressured to transact.

He accused the commission of operating under BJP influence and indicated potential consequences for its members. The Election Commission defended its processes, asserting that internal disagreements were normal and legal compliance was maintained.

Recent findings indicate a sharp rise in military component deliveries from China, along with a surge in cargo flights by Chinese airlines dedicated to supporting Iranian defense. stories.title: Engineers used 500,000 cubic yards of Mississippi River sand to build 7 islands and restore 270 acres
stories.summary: Engineers have successfully finalized a habitat restoration initiative at McGregor Lake, utilizing sand from the Mississippi River. This ambitious project involved the construction of seven islands, the enhancement of floodplain forests, and the protection of vital wetlands. The undertaking, spanning six years, has revitalized over 270 acres of aquatic habitats, significantly benefiting local wildlife and fostering greater biodiversity, all while striving to harmonize navigation and ecological preservation.

stories.title: SC asks EC to set timeline for resolving name, symbol dispute between TMC factions
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has urged the Election Commission to address the ongoing factional conflict within the All India Trinamool Congress. It has set a deadline for resolving the party's name and symbol, requiring a decision by Monday. Meanwhile, the Election Commission has temporarily assigned different names and symbols to opposing factions, both of which are vying for control of the party and its assets.

Australian homeowner blames six trees for damage to her 130-year-old home; court finds no link
stories.summary: A homeowner in Australia blamed six neighbouring trees for damage to her 130-year-old heritage home and sought $23,650.86 for repairs and tree removal. The NSW Land and Environment Court rejected her claim, finding that evidence did not establish a causal link between the trees and the damage, with moisture conditions and other factors identified as possible causes.

$100 Pocket Muon Detector: Students build handheld CosmicWatch; sparks citizen-science network
stories.summary: CosmicWatch is a compact and affordable particle detector that can be used for research and education purposes. Developed by physicist Spencer Axani, it costs about $100 and can be assembled easily. The portable device detects muons, allowing students to investigate cosmic-ray interactions and environmental changes. Researchers have successfully utilized it in high-altitude experiments and various scientific studies.

Badrinath Dham sees record 17.79 lakh pilgrims so far this year
stories.summary: Badrinath Dham has experienced a significant increase in pilgrimage, recording over 1.77 million visitors as of September 22. This surpasses the previous annual footfall record set in 2023. Visitor numbers have rebounded following declines due to the 2014 disaster and the Covid-19 pandemic. The government is enhancing facilities and safety measures to accommodate the growing number of devotees.

stories.summary: US President Donald Trump is planning to address Chinese President Xi Jinping regarding China's support for Iran. The discussion will follow reports linking Chinese entities to lethal satellite imagery provided to Iran prior to an attack. This attack on US troops in Jordan killed three soldiers and wounded others, marking a significant escalation. The meeting will also cover other critical topics like trade, AI, and Taiwan.

stories.title: Donald Trump says Canada has too many immigrants, but the math doesn’t add up
stories.summary: Canada has recently admitted a record number of permanent residents, primarily focusing on economic immigration programs. In contrast, the US processes significantly more green cards through family-based categories than Canada does. India's immigrants play critical roles in both countries, particularly in skilled job sectors. Trump's comments regarding immigration have drawn criticism for being racially charged and factually inaccurate.

stories.title: 1 Indian killed, 19 rescued after MV Cape Dao attacked off Oman; MEA calls for end to shipping attacks
stories.summary: In a tragic incident off the coast of Oman, the MV Cape Dao was attacked while en route to India, resulting in the death of one Indian seafarer. Nineteen others were successfully rescued, and the Indian Ministry of External Affairs expressed its condolences. The embassy in Oman is actively coordinating the repatriation of the crew, reiterating India's commitment to ensuring safe navigation in international waters.

stories.title: India's proposal under consideration for safe Black Sea shipping, Zelenskyy says
stories.summary: India, Egypt, and Turkey are exploring maritime truce options for safe navigation in the Black Sea. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy indicated readiness to support a truce if Russia responds positively. India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar is actively engaging with both Ukraine and Russia to mediate the conflict. Disruptions in shipping have impacted grain supplies globally, raising concerns among multiple countries.

stories.title: She turned America’s waste paper into Chinese packaging: How Zhang Yin built her billion-dollar empire
stories.summary: Zhang Yin launched her paper-trading venture in Hong Kong in 1985 with a simple investment strategy. Spotting a lucrative market in collecting waste paper from the United States to ship to China, she founded America Chung Nam, eventually becoming the top exporter of this recyclable material. Expanding further, she created Nine Dragons Paper, seeing tremendous growth in China’s booming economy.

stories.title: Another Trump-Putin meeting soon? US invites Russian Prez to G20 summit in Dec

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed readiness for negotiations regarding maritime security in the Black Sea.

The property is now on the market for $22.95 million after significant appreciation in real estate values. The estate features a six-bedroom residence and a guest house on 1.12 acres. Boone has decided to sell the property after living there for more than six decades.

stories.summary: Ronda, a small town in North Carolina, is facing financial challenges prompting officials to consider dissolution. stories.title: Fabergé figure bought in 1934 resurfaces in New York attic 79 years later, sells for $5.2 million
stories.summary: After being lost to time, a stunning Fabergé figurine depicting a bodyguard to Empress Alexandra Feodorovna has emerged from an attic in Rhinebeck, New York. Fetching an impressive $5.2 million at auction, this piece, originally commissioned by Emperor Nicholas II, epitomizes the exquisite craftsmanship of the early 20th century, setting a record for Fabergé hardstone figures and reflecting a renewed fascination with imperial Russian artistry.

Authorities have been directed to enhance lighting, security, and regular patrolling measures in these parks. Pink Police personnel will be deployed to improve safety during vulnerable hours at public locations.

stories.title: Tasmania removed invasive rice grass; fish species more than doubled in 3 years
stories.summary: Tasmania’s Duck Bay wetland is showing signs of recovery after years of work to remove invasive rice grass. Circular Head Landcare has reduced the weed from about 50 hectares to five, allowing native saltmarsh plants to return. University of Tasmania scientists found fish species increased from five to 11, with yellow-eye mullet and other species returning to restored areas.

The Congress party and its political allies long treated politics merely as a vehicle for dynastic interests and personal gain. Instead of serving as a means for public service, power became a tool for them to perpetuate dynastic rule and advance their own vested interests."

Trump dodged Yemen's plea for military support against Houthis: Report
stories.summary: President Trump did not commit US forces to aid Yemen against the Houthis. Yemeni President Alimi sought American backing for his government's efforts. US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman, discussing a ceasefire. Trump reportedly called off planned airstrikes against Houthi targets. The conflict has caused significant casualties and displacement within Yemen.

Napa family rebuilt winery after 2017 wildfire for $30M; nine years later, $37M debt puts estate at risk
stories.summary: Signorello Estate winery faces an October auction after a series of devastating setbacks. The winery burned down in 2017, and rebuilding efforts faced significant delays and cost increases. Global wine sales have declined, impacting the business's revenue streams and financial stability. The owner owes $37 million to American AgCredit, which rejected a $16 million cash offer. This potential foreclosure threatens a 50-year family legacy and the jobs of ten employees.

stories.title: In 2008, a collector spotted an unusual Eisenhower dollar inside a tube of ordinary coins
stories.summary: A fascinating discovery has emerged, as a rare 1971 Eisenhower dollar prototype coin is set to hit the auction block once more. Found tucked away in an inconspicuous tube of standard coins, this remarkable piece is one of only three surviving prototypes from the United States Mint's inaugural space-themed dollar. Originally selling for $264,000 in 2008, this unique coin will see bids close on October 18, 2026.

'I am Hindu and my mom is not white': Ro Khanna asks Dinesh D'Souza if this makes him less American
‘Only 2 people called me in 3 years’: Indian woman shares ‘reality of NRI’ after moving to US
A 70-foot land dispute turned ugly as Louisiana neighbours traded signs, lights and a dead cow
stories.summary: Two Louisiana neighbouring families spent years arguing over a disputed 70-foot strip of land. The conflict escalated after one family put up large “NO TRESPASSING” signs, bright lights, loud generators and even a dead cow near the boundary. A Louisiana appeals court upheld the old fence as the property line and affirmed $15,000 in damages and a permanent injunction.

The 'rebel' hit by rebellion: How Mamata Banerjee's TMC journey has come full circle
stories.summary: Nearly three decades after Mamata Banerjee broke away from the Congress to build the Trinamool Congress, she finds herself in a very different battle: fighting a rebellion within her own party, a dispute over its name and symbol, and a stronger BJP in Bengal has pushed back to the 'sister party'.

He lost his job during Covid; six years later, his lawn mowing network spans 50 states
stories.summary: In 2020, New Jersey resident Brian Schwartz lost his job during the pandemic and began mowing lawns for free to help older neighbours. That one‑off act grew into I Want To Mow Your Lawn, a volunteer‑run nonprofit now linking more than 2,000 volunteers in all 50 states with seniors, veterans and others who need temporary yard help.

At 78, Nashville songwriter Jerry Vandiver rescues foxes with mange; 60+ treated this year
stories.summary: In a heartwarming display of compassion, Nashville songwriter Jerry Vandiver has devoted himself to rescuing sick red foxes. He skillfully traps these ailing creatures, transporting them to Walden’s Puddle Wildlife Center for much-needed care. In August alone, his dedication earned him 234 volunteer hours, ultimately assisting numerous animals. Through his efforts, he ensures that these foxes can heal and safely return to their natural environments.

stories.title: California acquired 640 acres near Pioneertown for Joshua tree conservation; tribal plans ahead
stories.summary: California has acquired 640 acres of western Joshua tree habitat northwest of Pioneertown in San Bernardino County, securing land that researchers identify as highly likely to remain suitable for the species in the future. The newly acquired property sits northwest of Pioneertown, in a desert region where western Joshua trees form an important part of the landscape. The acquisition covers 640 acres and was completed by CDFW on August 24 using money from the Western Joshua Tree Conservation Fund.

stories.title: Egyptian archaeologists uncovered rare rock-cut tombs at an ancient Nile Delta site
stories.summary: In an exciting archaeological discovery, experts in Egypt announced the unearthing of unusual rock-cut tombs at Tell el-Yahudiya, tracing back to the New Kingdom and continuing through the Late Period. Above these ancient burials, traces of a Roman encampment were uncovered, highlighting how the location remained significant across multiple historical timelines, illuminating Tell el-Yahudiya's legacy.

Family farmed Wisconsin land for 179 years; now bulldozers make way for homes
stories.summary: A Wisconsin family farmed the same West Bend land since 1847, with George Muth the fifth generation to work the fields. On 18 September 2026, bulldozers demolished the old barn as the site, at Paradise Drive and River Road, was cleared for a new housing development. The project is expected to bring about 400 multifamily residences, ending nearly 180 years of Muth family farming and altering a once-rural corner of Washington County.

stories.title: Inside Rick Ross’ Georgia estate, bought from Evander Holyfield for $5.8 million
stories.summary: Rick Ross bought Evander Holyfield’s 235-acre Georgia estate for $5.8 million in 2014 and later added 87 acres for $1 million. He renamed the roughly 322-acre property the Promise Land. The estate has a 45,000-square-foot, 109-room mansion, a 350,000-gallon pool and has also featured in the filmComing 2 America.

Govt asks people to use Sanchar Saathi to verify mobile connections, handsets
stories.summary: In an effort to enhance mobile security, the government has urged citizens to validate their mobile connections through the Sanchar Saathi Portal. This platform allows individuals to review all mobile numbers registered under their identity. Recently, the Department of Telecom blacklisted an agent involved in unlawful SIM activations. Citizens are advised against sharing SIM cards registered in their names to curb potential misuse and maintain a safer communication landscape.

Meet 'Little Einstein' Laurent Simons: 16-year-old PhD holder now researching how to slow human ageing
stories.summary: At just 16 years old, Laurent Simons has achieved remarkable academic feats, completing a PhD in theoretical quantum physics and diving into a second doctorate in medical science and artificial intelligence. His groundbreaking research aims to unravel the mysteries of ageing and enhance human longevity. Despite his extraordinary intellect, he embraces the joys of typical teenage life in-between his studies, showcasing a well-rounded personality.

stories.title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann’s big push to make state drug-free
stories.summary: In a significant shift, the Punjab government has enhanced its fight against drugs by extending initiatives beyond police interventions. This comprehensive approach includes prevention efforts within schools and active youth involvement. The strategy emphasizes community vigilance and improved access to treatment. Numerous arrests and major drug seizures were reported, and the expansion of treatment facilities has led to a notable rise in admissions.

Now the same will be referred to the expenditure finance committee, inter-ministerial body under finmin’s dept of expenditure which will evaluate the same before being submitted to the cabinet for formal approval.

Ontario couple’s C$200 yard-sale find, an E J Hughes painting, sells for C$402,500
stories.summary: An Ontario couple bought a landscape painting for C$200 at a rural yard sale in 2001, unaware it was by renowned Canadian artist E.J. Hughes. Six years later, Lake Okanagan was identified as his work and sold for C$402,500. Hughes, known for his detailed British Columbia landscapes, later saw his paintings fetch millions at auction.

stories.title: Alabama agencies release 1,500 rare mussels into Paint Rock River after years of restoration
stories.summary: In an effort to revitalize the Paint Rock River's ecosystem, conservationists have introduced rare native freshwater mussels into the waters of northeast Alabama. This release is significant as these mussels are vital for filtering water and fostering biodiversity. The initiative is part of a broader commitment to preserving endangered mussel species, reflecting years of dedicated restoration work in this biodiverse watershed.

The Election Commission is under fire both politically and legally regarding its verification practices, with the final electoral roll set for release on November 4.

Ever since he started posting videos against drugs, he had been receiving threats and being harassed. Amidst grand claims about a drug-free Punjab, such incidents have raised serious questions on the accountability of the AAP government and the administration."

The agreement comes as technology leaders warn that rapid advances in AI could create serious risks if research continues without adequate safeguards.

stories.title: Putin-backed United Russia leads Duma polls at 57.5% as Ukraine war looms
stories.summary: The three-day parliamentary election ended on Sunday, with the final results expected by September 25. Early figures released by Russia's Central Election Commission showed United Russia well ahead of other parties. The election is the first parliamentary vote since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. United Russia won 324 of the 450 seats in the State Duma in the previous parliamentary election in 2021.

stories.summary: Iranian authorities accused the centre of operating for years without the required licence and said it had gone beyond language teaching. They alleged that it was involved in activities they considered harmful to Iranian culture and national security, including identifying and building networks and helping skilled Iranians leave the country.

She challenged societal expectations placed on women regarding marriage and motherhood while discussing fertility. She said she has been going through a difficult period but feels supported and is prioritising her well-being.

stories.summary: Queen Elizabeth II’s Queen’s Green Canopy began in 2021 as a tree-planting project marking her Platinum Jubilee. stories.summary: On the market is a remarkable 135-acre Christmas tree farm in Warren County, New Jersey, a family-owned gem for eighty years. This unique estate features a stunning 1839 timber-frame barn and a charming guest cottage. With farmland preservation in place, buyers can ensure this agricultural haven remains untouched by urban growth, and the sale includes necessary equipment and established customer pathways.

stories.title: Iran warns US, allies against new attack, threatens retaliation
stories.summary: Iran has reiterated its commitment to retaliate against the United States and its allies for any major offensive, citing credible intelligence indicating such actions are imminent. In response, President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Tehran about potential severe repercussions. The recent violence, including attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi sites, has aggravated tensions and disrupted regional energy supplies and maritime operations.

stories.summary: An eighth-grade student from Pennsylvania, Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, has become a national finalist for her groundbreaking GERD drug delivery system. She created an innovative controlled release mechanism aimed at prolonging the effectiveness of antacid medications. This recognition follows her success at regional science fairs, and she will vie for educational accolades in Washington, D.C. in October, showcasing her dedication to improving heartburn treatment outcomes.

stories.summary: President Donald Trump will meet New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Monday. The meeting will focus on issues affecting New York City and its residents. Concerns over artificial intelligence also remain a significant global topic.

stories.summary: After building a budget-friendly home in New York for just $40,000 and selling it for a striking $290,000, a couple made a spontaneous decision to relocate to Florida. Without job commitments in place, Jessica Patrzyk transitioned into real estate, while her husband chased his passion as a diving instructor. As they explore Florida’s delights and face new career paths, they also navigate the complexities of stricter local building codes.

stories.title: Punjab CM launches 'Mann Da Munafa' door-to-door campaign highlighting welfare initiatives
In 2016, Michael Dell paid $10.9 million for a Boston penthouse; 10 years later the barely used...
stories.summary: Michael Dell's luxurious penthouse in Boston is hitting the auction block with a starting bid of $6.5 million. Initially acquired for $10.9 million a decade ago, this stunning property is situated on the 59th floor of the renowned Millennium Tower. Following several attempts at traditional sale routes, Dell has opted for an auction format that wraps up in late October, making it a must-watch event for high-end real estate enthusiasts.

Iran's command stated any US attack would face retaliation without limitations. Iran relayed truce conditions to the US through Qatari mediators. Trump signaled openness to talks with Iranian President Pezeshkian.

stories.title: A Wyoming-to-Canada wildlife project has supported 204 crossings and helped protect 59 million acres
stories.summary: A conservation project connecting wild habitats from Wyoming to Canada's Yukon is a finalist for Prince William's Earthshot Prize. The Yellowstone to Yukon initiative protects 59 million acres and supports 204 wildlife crossings. This project brings together diverse groups to build safe passage for animals across highways. Indigenous communities manage about one-quarter of the protected land within the corridor. The initiative plans to protect another 50 million acres by 2030.

stories.title: In 1992, Elton John began buying Atlanta apartments and combined six into a 13,000-square-foot home
stories.summary: Sir Elton John's expansive Atlanta residence has been sold for $7.225 million. This high-rise property was strategically priced to attract multiple competitive offers. The combined six apartments were developed over thirty years into a luxurious sky mansion. John used this home as his primary North American base during his touring years. The sale concludes the transfer of the largest residential space in the Park Place tower.

stories.title: Israel President pardons soldier who shot wounded Palestinian attacker dead in West Bank
After grandmother loses sight, teen builds $170 AI glasses
stories.summary: Seventeen-year-old Alexander Du has made waves with his creation, IRIS, an AI-powered wearable aimed at aiding the visually impaired. This device uses vibration technology to assist users in navigation and obstacle detection, providing a cost-effective alternative to pricey commercial smart glasses. His remarkable efforts were acknowledged in a ceremony at the White House, as he aspires to expand IRIS's reach to countless individuals worldwide.

BJP, Congress trade barbs over PM Modi mimicry at Rahul Gandhi’s Indore event
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized the Congress party after a comedian mimicked Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This performance occurred during an event attended by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in Madhya Pradesh. Union ministers and other BJP leaders targeted the opposition party and the Congress MP over the skit. Congress leaders defended the program, stating that all mothers deserve respect and questioning BJP's selective outrage.

Florida is sinking 3 million pounds of repurposed concrete culverts off Destin-Fort Walton Beach
stories.summary: In an innovative approach, old concrete pipes are being repurposed as artificial reefs in the Gulf of Mexico. This initiative will create three new underwater habitats near Destin-Fort Walton Beach. These structures offer vital shelter for various marine species and bolster local fisheries. Additionally, this project enhances Florida's Coastal Corridor program by linking essential marine ecosystems, benefiting charter boats, fishermen, and scuba divers alike.

1887 winery hidden for decades now part of $35M Napa estate
stories.summary: A 151-acre Napa Valley vineyard property is now for sale at thirty-five million dollars. This historic estate features a restored 1887 stone winery and about twenty-five acres of vineyards. The property includes a recently built main house and a private lake with a small cabin. Artist Matt Rogers is selling the land his father purchased years ago. Ellen DeGeneres and Portia previously considered buying this unique Napa Valley property.

stories.title: In 2022, Adele bought Sylvester Stallone’s 3.5-acre Beverly Park mansion for $58 million; four years...
stories.summary: In a bold real estate move, Adele bought Sylvester Stallone's stunning Beverly Hills home for $58 million in 2022. Her plans? A total demolition and rebuild of the luxurious estate, while preserving the iconic Rocky Balboa bronze statue that adds a unique flair to the deal. With a modern design featuring expansive glass panels, this renovation is set to reshape the property over the next few years.

Healthcare goes digital: When doctors go behind the app wall, who gets left behind?
stories.summary: Digital healthcare presents a dual landscape, offering innovative benefits while simultaneously imposing hurdles for various patients. Younger generations tend to embrace online health services with ease, yet reliable internet access and digital literacy remain essential for comprehensive medical support. Initiatives such as ABHA strive to digitally integrate healthcare systems. Ultimately, technology should serve to enhance, rather than substitute, the necessary human touch in patient care.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Ukraine launches over 1,000 drones at Russia; Akhilesh’s UP poll strategy & more
stories.summary: Ukraine launched over one thousand drones at Russia in a significant overnight attack. stories.summary: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami visited Badrinath Dham recently. He participated in a traditional Chachdance and enjoyed local milk and jalebi. The Chief Minister reviewed arrangements for the ongoing Char Dham pilgrimage. He noted the historic first phase saw fifty-one lakh pilgrims. A cultural festival is also being held in Badrinath.

stories.title: '27,000 votes, 27 seats': Akhilesh lays out Samajwadi Party strategy to counter BJP in UP polls
Erika Kirk Idaho Event Dispute: Owens, TPUSA split on student assembly; questions over opt-in
stories.summary: Candace Owens and Turning Point USA are disputing how students attended a Club America event at Nampa Christian School in Idaho. Owens says students were brought to the event as a school assembly and did not voluntarily sign up. TPUSA spokesperson Andrew Kolvet says students could opt out and three did. The disagreement has also raised questions about Erika Kirk's youth outreach.
